Signs of the World

Drinking water

History

ISO 7010, the international safety sign standard first published in 2003, includes a sign for drinking water that shows a tap filling a glass.

Adoption

The tap and glass say "safe to drink" without a word. The United Nations recognized safe drinking water and sanitation as a human right in 2010, yet about one in four people still lacked a safely managed supply in 2024.
